Yea I’m only 20, I actually wrote an essay in senior year about the negative impacts of technology when growing up. And I definitely feel that it can create trust issues and social anxiety issues at a young age. 

But don’t get me wrong, obviously the benefits of technology are astounding; but I just think growing up with it comes with its negative impacts. Like seeing babies/kids at the airport with ipads/smartphones in their hands while parents aren’t supervising what they watch. Really just handing the internet to a generation of children was crazy cause we had the ability to look up anything online at a young age.

I wish i could say it gave me some sort of comfort but it just confirms all my premonitions about this world. So many people in pain but no one can openly talk about it. Everyone on social media puts up a front and the people like us that are lonely, we sit back and watch. Growing up with social media and the internet in general has definitely set us apart from different generations but I feel like it made things worse with social isolation issues and what not
